name: table
useFor: Use Table for records people read across (threads, seats, runs) and variant="compare" for a plan or feature comparison: TableGroup opens each section, row names are TableHead with scope="row", and TableYes and TableNo mark what is included. Use variant="prose" inside an article. Keep the shadcn parts (TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableFooter, TableCaption); mark a chosen row with data-state="selected". For sorting, selection and pages use DataTable.
constraints: Zebra stripes or filled head rows
A check icon or an orange mark for yes
Rows that move under the pointer
source: The Hoplite website's pricing comparison (.pr-table, .pr-table__group, .pr-yes, .pr-no on /pricing) and the blog table (.bp-table)

examples.content:

title: Table
description: Ruled, not boxed: Kode Mono column heads over the strong rule and 48px rows of 14px ink with a quiet rule between them; the compare variant is the pricing table (Chakra Petch 20px plan heads, group rows, a filled ink hexagon for yes and a slate dash for no) and the prose variant the blog's 16px table. A table wider than its frame scrolls sideways and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-x).
